_doc: What KIND of business each sponsor of the ν.998/1979 άρθρο 42 §3 scheme is. The basis is SECTOR — readable from the company's own registered name or from the act appointing it — never corporate ownership, which is a legal claim needing per-company verification. Every assignment carries its basis. Keys are the display names queries_extra._sponsor_group produces; the coverage is pinned by the test suite.

ALFA WOOD GROUP.basis: timber and wood panels; its projects are plane-disease sanitation

AZOE RESORT ΜΟΝΟΠΡΟΣΩΠΗ Α.Ε..basis: a resort operator, as its name states

Coca-Cola (3Ε / Hellas).basis: soft drinks; the acts name both legal entities of the restatement pair

ECORECOVERY S.A.basis: the act names it «ΑΝΩΝΥΜΗ ΕΤΑΙΡΙΑ ΑΝΑΚΤΗΣΗΣ ΑΠΟΒΛΗΤΩΝ» — waste recovery

EREN Ελλάς / Eren Groupe.basis: Eren Groupe S.A. (Luxembourg) and its Greek arm — renewable energy

Maxima INSURANCE.basis: an insurer, as its name states

NOVA Telecommunications & Media.basis: telecoms and media, as its name states

Nordia A.E..basis: appointed in one act as «Nordia A.E. - Marmoline», the building-materials brand

TATOΪ Club & ΕΛΙΑ Κατασκευαστική.basis: a members' club appointed jointly with a construction company; grouped by the club, which is the sponsor of record

Ίδρυμα Π. & Α. Κανελλοπούλου.basis: a charitable foundation, as its name states

ΑΔΜΗΕ.basis: Ανεξάρτητος Διαχειριστής Μεταφοράς Ηλεκτρικής Ενέργειας — the transmission system operator, as its own name states

ΑΚΡΙΤΑΣ Α.Ε..basis: wood products; its project is plane-disease sanitation on the Σπερχειός

ΔΕΔΔΗΕ.basis: Διαχειριστής Ελληνικού Δικτύου Διανομής Ηλεκτρικής Ενέργειας — the distribution network operator, as its own name states

ΔΕΗ.basis: Δημόσια Επιχείρηση Ηλεκτρισμού — the power utility

ΔΕΠΑ Εμπορίας Α.Ε..basis: Δημόσια Επιχείρηση Αερίου, trading arm — gas supply

ΔΟΞΙΑΔΗΣ ΠΛΑΣ ΜΟΝΟΠΡΟΣΩΠΗ ΕΠΕ.basis: ΔΟΞΙΑΔΗΣ ΠΛΑΣ — a planning and engineering consultancy; its act appoints it for the μελέτη, not for works

ΕΝΩΣΗ ΞΕΝΟΔΟΧΩΝ ΡΟΔΟΥ.basis: the Rhodes hoteliers' association, as its name states

Εθνική Τράπεζα.basis: a bank, as its name states

Ελληνικά Πετρέλαια / HELLENiQ ENERGY.basis: the refiner; the acts name both the old «Ελληνικά Πετρέλαια Α.Ε.» and the renamed HELLENiQ ENERGY Holdings S.A.

Εταιρεία Προστ. Βιοποικιλότητας Θράκης.basis: a biodiversity-protection society, seated at Δαδιά

ΖΙΤΑΚΑΤ ΑΤΕΒΕ.basis: ΑΤΕΒΕ = Ανώνυμη Τεχνική Εταιρεία — a construction firm

Ομάδα Σύμπραξις (Παπαστράτος).basis: a sponsorship partnership whose funder the acts record as Παπαστράτος — tobacco

ΣΤΑΝΤΑ Α.Ε..basis: the act names it «ΣΤΑΝΤΑ Α.Ε. ΕΤΑΙΡΕΙΑ ΔΙΑΧΕΙΡΙΣΗΣ ΑΚΙΝΗΤΩΝ» — property management

Τ & Τ ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΕΣ Α.Ε..basis: «ΚΑΤΑΣΚΕΥΕΣ» — a construction firm, as its name states

ΤΕΡΝΑ Α.Ε..basis: a construction company, as its name states

ΤΕΡΝΑ Λευκόλιθοι Α.Ε..basis: magnesite mining and materials; carries the ΤΕΡΝΑ name of the same group — the one ownership link visible in the names themselves

Τράπεζα EUROBANK A.E..basis: a bank, as its name states

Τράπεζα Πειραιώς.basis: a bank, as its name states
